scope.perspective: Simulated Proteus design lens: world coherence, exploration rhythm, readable environmental toys; not the named creator’s opinion.
scope.evidence: All 21 actual 390×844 screenshots and matching manifest at revision e8368253 in /tmp/e7-final-capturas; three closure screenshots and matching manifest at revision 3c9d5dbc in /tmp/e7-capturas-cierre. Inspected selected source src/voice-guide.js, src/journey-garden.js and src/places-ring.js at the initial review. The coordinator states closure changes are limited to journal/book/favorites layout and preserve world, garden, ruins and music.
scope.constraints: Black space, Geist Mono, small cube, preserved approved world/music and geometry, eleven sequential places and slow transitions accepted as intentional. Garden and ruins low salience is assessed as a bounded static visual/comprehension risk, not a proven input failure or authorization to alter preserved art.

scoreBasis.visual: Rendered chapter and place screenshots have distinct silhouettes and environmental textures inside a consistent sparse grammar. Garden and ruins action geometry has weak salience against ambient marks at this mobile size.
scoreBasis.audio: Unobserved: no listening. The manifest reporting running audio and source describing sound are not perceptual evidence.
scoreBasis.creativity: Observed visual concepts plus source rules: care and wilting plants, storm circles, geometric crystals, guiding boats and rebuilding columns turn the same small cube into several coherent environmental toys. Scored conceptual invention, not experiential success.
scoreBasis.sensation: Unobserved: no live play or listening; still images cannot establish embodied response, rhythm feel or exploration flow.
scoreBasis.cohesion: The chapter silhouettes, restrained overlays, ring compass, route label, garden-specific help and circular song presentation connect the journey into one authored world. Sequential unlocking is an accepted premise.
scoreBasis.polish: Observed mobile composition and help hierarchy are controlled and readable, with clear primary continuation actions. The baseline distinction between actionable and decorative world marks remains less resolved than the menus. No timing or interaction correctness inferred. Closure 32-libro.png exposes the first named card and its musical function in one frame; 34-favoritos.png exposes a named saved place and direct travel action. These local layout improvements do not resolve the world-readability uncertainty and do not change the score.

strengths.observation: Large simple silhouettes and different field textures establish place identity while the tiny cube and generous black space retain a consistent scale. Crystal lattice, dune streaks and the lighthouse beam give exploration distinct visual destinations.
The nearby compass and concise Jardín · 600 m label provide a legible next direction without covering the world. The distant gold column gives that guidance an environmental counterpart.

Garden help describes approaching, planting, watering and harvesting as concrete gestures. Its contextual hint uses the same distance and plant-stage rules as the toy, and Ver el gesto offers an explicit replay.

The closure collection shows Fósil de ritmo and its musical role before scrolling. The saved-place view gives Mi primer lugar an immediate Ir a este lugar action, making a collected object and a remembered destination readable as usable parts of exploration.

findings.finding: In the captured initial garden state, eight similar faint dashed beds compete with ambient loops and plant marks; there is no immediately dominant bed to approach in this frame. The more explicit demonstration is delayed or intermittent by source design.
findings.consequence: The still presents a weaker initial approach cue than the contextual help. Whether players hesitate or fail to identify a bed is an untested comprehension risk; motion and the delayed demonstration may resolve it.
findings.remedy: First observe the existing demonstration and initial planting in uninterrupted play on a physical target device. If hesitation is reproduced and a guidance change is authorized within preservation constraints, evaluate a temporary nearest-bed cue; do not alter approved geometry on this still alone.
findings.classificationScope: Verified static visual observation only; first-use confusion and input failure are untested.

findings.finding: The rebuilding stacks are rendered as very faint dotted vertical marks over many ambient arcs; their small white bases carry most of their visible weight.
findings.consequence: In this frame the ruin stacks have less salience than crystal shapes or the lighthouse beam. Reduced first-use comprehension is a bounded risk, not a demonstrated failure in motion.
findings.remedy: Observe approach and rebuilding feedback in motion on a physical target device before changing preserved art. If comprehension difficulty is reproduced, evaluate an authorized contextual guidance cue while retaining approved world geometry.
findings.classificationScope: Verified static visual observation only; difficulty discovering or using the structures is untested.

findings.finding: These scripted stills cannot verify whether demonstrations arrive at a helpful moment, whether the slow travel sustains curiosity, or whether planting and watering are readable in motion.
findings.consequence: Exploration rhythm and first-use comprehension remain untested by this review; no sensory score is assigned.
findings.remedy: Observe one uninterrupted first-use journey with actual input and listening, including first garden planting and travel toward the next portal, before drawing temporal usability conclusions.

limits: Read-only independent review; no browser, tests, edits to the repository, audio rendering or listening.
All captures are scripted local fixtures; forced panels and book cards are not evidence of natural discovery, rarity or human comprehension.
Findings concern the supplied mobile frames; no claim about other displays, physical-device brightness, accessibility testing or a player’s eventual learning.

Closure inspection covers only the three supplied journal/place/favorite screenshots. Unchanged world findings retain their original e8368253 screenshot evidence; no full recapture or live run of 3c9d5dbc was performed by this reviewer. Scores remain independent and unchanged.
